verdict.rationale: Steel is an API-first product: the core capabilities (sessions, CAPTCHAs, credentials, files, proxies, auth context) are exposed as documented API endpoints with a published OpenAPI spec. Even the UI-centric agent-trace timeline has a dedicated Agent Traces API, and a CLI covers full browser workflows. missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence that dashboard-only functions (account, API keys, team or billing settings, replay viewing) have API equivalents, and independent hands-on confirmation of UI/API parity.
